summary: Documents can be archived, deleted and restored, in the web app and by asking Nora in the chat.
details: Archive takes a document off the Documents list and off what Nora sees of the room's documents; it still opens by its link, shows under the new Archived filter, and can be restored.
Delete takes a document off every list and its link stops opening, for everyone. Nothing is erased: ask Nora in the chat to bring it back.

Nora can archive, delete or restore a document made in the room when somebody asks (her new document_set_status tool). She sees the room's last few archived and deleted documents, so "bring it back" works in a later conversation too, and a document's link code works as well. She will not edit an archived or deleted one until it is restored.
Whoever can open a document in the web app can archive or delete it there.
limitations: A deleted document cannot be restored from the web app, only by asking Nora in its room (she sees its three most recently put-away documents) or by the operator.
Nothing is ever erased for real: there is no purge.
Ships with the document tools, behind [documents] enabled.
